narrative.title: The Snake-Queue Boarding Call
narrative.scenario: A themed attraction loads guests from a binary-tree map of queue pens. The host calls one pen-depth at a time, but alternates the walking direction each round to keep the line moving past both entrances: first pen-depth left to right, next right to left, and so on. The announcer needs the exact call order grouped by pen-depth for the day's schedule.
narrative.inputFormat: The root of a binary tree given as a level-order array where null marks a missing child.
narrative.outputFormat: Return a list of lists: level i holds that level's values, left-to-right for even levels (0-indexed) and right-to-left for odd levels.

testCases.explanation: A single pen holds a single guest.

hintLevels: Level 1: This is plain level order with a direction flip per level — collect normally, present differently.
Level 2: Snapshot the queue size per level, gather the level's values, and reverse the buffer on every odd level.
Level 3: Children always enqueue left-then-right regardless of direction; only the display order alternates.
